data.description:
# Live prompt-eval CI job scores coverage 0.0 on every spec

## The gap

`.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml`'s `eval-live` job calls `ev.run_eval(pid, max_cases=cap)`
directly (`:136`). It does **not** wrap the call in `rebar.llm.gate_source.gate_read_root`, and
it does **not** set `REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED`.

Since epic raze-vet-ditch landed the agent-op safeguard, every agentic filesystem tool call
made outside a gate session raises:

> agentic filesystem tools was attempted OUTSIDE the repo-snapshot gate process (epic
> raze-vet-ditch): a tool-using agent must run inside rebar.llm.gate_source.gate_read_root
> (attested snapshot or explicit local), never against the server's mutable checkout.

(`src/rebar/llm/gate_context.py:144-162`)

`run_eval` treats a solver exception as an **UNSCORED case, not a crash**
(`src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:670-682`), so the job does not fail loudly. It records every case
as a run error, computes `coverage = 0.0`, fails `coverage_ok`, and reports
`epoch_pass = [false, false, false]`.

The job is `continue-on-error: true` (`:95`) and only emits
`::warning::live eval regressions (advisory)`. So a **total** scoring failure is
indistinguishable from an ordinary advisory regression, and the live eval corpus has not
actually been scoring anything since the safeguard landed.

## Reproduction (measured)

Full dataset, no cap, worktree `impl-e508` at `origin/main` 0e7401446c58:

```
python -c "from rebar.llm.evals import eval as ev; ev.run_eval('code-review-tests')"
→ passed=false  coverage=0.0  epoch_pass=[false,false,false]  elapsed=40.4s
```

All **117** case-runs (39 cases x 3 epochs) carry the identical gate error in the JUnit
`message=` attribute. 40 seconds for 117 agentic code reviews is itself the tell: no model
call was ever made.

Wrapping the same call in a local-mode gate session makes the run proceed and reach the model:

```python
handle = gate_source.resolve_gate_handle(None, gate_source.SOURCE_LOCAL, root, fetch=False)
with gate_source.gate_read_root(handle):
    res = ev.run_eval("code-review-tests", repo_root=root)
```

## Why it matters

Any AC of the form "the eval spec scores at or above its recorded pass bar, reproducible from
the committed spec" is currently **not reproducible from the committed CI path** — only from a
hand-wrapped local run. Several closed stories carry exactly that AC shape.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The `eval-live` job's live step runs `run_eval` inside a gate session, choosing the
      source mode explicitly rather than relying on the configured default. `REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED`
      is NOT used — the override is an audited escape hatch, not the fix.
- [ ] A regression test asserts that the eval entry point used by CI runs under a gate session:
      with the safeguard active and no override set, the entry point completes with
      `coverage > 0` against an injected offline `solve`, and the unwrapped call is shown to
      produce run errors. The test must fail against the current workflow's call shape.
- [ ] `run_eval` (or the CI entry point) distinguishes "every case errored" from "cases scored
      and failed" — a 0.0-coverage epoch is reported as a RUN FAILURE, not an advisory
      regression, so this class of total failure cannot be silent again.
- [ ] The portability constraint holds: the gate-session requirement is enforced in-process,
      not by a GitHub-Actions-only step, so a project on another CI provider or no CI provider
      gets the same behaviour.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Live prompt-eval CI job scores coverage 0.0 on every spec — run_eval is called outside a gate session
